baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus verb from س ب ح governs a totalizing upper-and-lower construction and closes with the paired roots ع ز ز and ح ك م.
baseline_models.mechanism: Upper and lower creation leave no neutral zone: all existence jointly worships and clears God of defect. The final attributes make that testimony functional, since it addresses power that cannot be defeated and wisdom that does not misjudge its order.

activation_trace.role: Devotion makes the predicate an act performed by the whole created field.
Exoneration makes creation's act deny defect or rival power to God.
Worship supplies the sole recipient of the collective act.
The encompassing upper domain supplies one pole of the total field.
The lower domain opposite the sky completes the spatial totality.
Prevailing power explains why no created region can frustrate the order it attests.
Accurate wisdom makes cosmic order intelligible rather than merely coerced.

changed_reading.before: A general report that everything in the heavens and earth praised God.
changed_reading.after: A total-field testimony in which every level of creation worships and clears God of defect by standing within an undefeatable and knowingly ordered reality.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The motion branches of س ب ح span the focus's upper and lower poles, while the final attribute pair joins force to restraint and exactness.
baseline_models.mechanism: Praise need not be voiced: swimming, running, and room to return make the cosmos a field of trajectories. Yet power is paired with repair-oriented restraint and a bridle image, so these motions disclose force that is directed rather than arbitrary.

activation_trace.role: Swimming and running supply motion as a material mode of praise.
Room for going and returning turns praise into patterned circulation.
Elevation supplies the upper extent of the field of motion.
The lower counterpart completes the field through which created things move.
Cohesive solidity stabilizes the diverse motions without making force ultimate.
Restraint for repair directs power toward corrective order.
The bridle image makes control of force concrete.

changed_reading.before: Cosmic praise is mainly imagined as a universal chorus under raw might.
changed_reading.after: The cosmos also praises kinetically: its courses and returns enact power that is precisely reined, repaired, and ordered.

context_deltas.mechanism: An enclosure calculated to preserve its occupants is reversed from within and ends as ruined habitation; the command to transfer one condition into a lesson makes that reversal legible. Earthly structures thus testify by exposing failed claims to invulnerability.

activation_trace.role: True prevailing power is the standard against which the fortress claim is tested.
Exoneration lets the exposed failure deny that created protection rivals God.
Protection by enclosure supplies the apparent self-sufficient defense.
Expectation supplies the failed calculation that enclosure would suffice.
Turning a thing from its face models defense becoming self-exposure.
Ruined settlement gives the reversal a visible material result.
Making one condition instruct another authorizes the event as transferable disclosure.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from confidence in enclosure to an uncalculated arrival, inward fear, and houses ruined by their occupants.
The final imperative explicitly asks perceptive readers to cross from event to lesson.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enclosure, failed calculation, inward reversal, ruin, and an explicit lesson; I infer an earthly mode of involuntary testimony to the focus attributes. Alternatively, the opening praise may only frame the event.

changed_reading.before: Creation's praise is a stable background for the historical scene.
changed_reading.after: The scene participates in praise: a supposedly invulnerable structure turns against its claimants and materially clears divine power of comparison.

context_deltas.mechanism: Land can be cut or left standing, but both alternatives remain under authorization; resulting property is described through return and directed circulation rather than closed accumulation. Wise power becomes governance of material transformations and social flows.

activation_trace.role: Productive ground makes earth a transformable material participant.
Corrective restraint limits destructive or monopolizing action.
Severance supplies one permitted transformation of rooted material.
Leaving a thing in place supplies the opposed governed treatment.
Authorization prevents the alternatives from becoming arbitrary mastery of land.
Return supplies movement by which value is released from prior possession.
Transfer among hands supplies the social circulation that the rule regulates.

structural_cues: Cutting and leaving are paired and subordinated to permission.
Repeated return terminology leads to a rule explicitly blocking exclusive circulation among the wealthy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed land treatments, authorization, return, and circulation; I infer that focus wisdom channels material and wealth flows and that compliance is earthly praise. Alternatively, the rules may exemplify wisdom without defining praise.

changed_reading.before: Earth praises as an undifferentiated region of creation.
changed_reading.after: Earthly matter and wealth praise through governed transformation and return, resisting their hardening into private permanence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earth branch for the stranger becomes active when movement between dwellings creates displaced people. Hosts answer despite a gap in their own condition by preferring newcomers and overcoming possessive withholding: spatial displacement is repaired through ethical redistribution of place and goods.

activation_trace.role: The earth-associated stranger gives the focus domain a latent displaced-person image.
Repair-oriented restraint checks self-claim so social space can be restored.
Movement from one dwelling to another supplies the stranger's condition.
Choosing another over oneself supplies the reversal that repairs displacement.
A gap in one's own condition makes hospitality costly rather than effortless.
Possessive withholding names the blocked flow that must be overcome.

structural_cues: The displaced group is followed by residents defined through welcome, inward lack, and preference for others.
Movement from lost dwellings to received newcomers turns geography into a social relation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies migration, other-preference, scarcity, and resistance to withholding; I infer that these acts repair the focus earth's stranger-condition and enact praise. Alternatively, these virtues may remain consequences of distribution only.

changed_reading.before: Earth is merely the lower spatial half of the praising cosmos.
changed_reading.after: Earth also praises when inhabitants make room for the displaced, converting geographic loss and private scarcity into shared habitation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Visible assembly, fortification, and high walls simulate solidity, but expectation mistakes exterior hardness for cohesion. Scattered hearts negate the visible whole. The focus pair becomes diagnostic: true strength is coherent order, and wisdom sees through surfaces to internal relation.

activation_trace.role: Material cohesion supplies the focus model of genuine strength.
Accurate knowledge distinguishes outer hardness from inner coherence.
Joining dispersed parts supplies the appearance of a collective body.
Encircling protection externalizes the group's claim to security.
The elevated wall supplies the hard boundary behind which unity is staged.
Supposition marks the mistaken conversion of appearance into reality.
The inner organ relocates decisive evidence from walls to inward condition.
Dispersion directly cancels the claimed internal unity.
Restraining intellect names the absent operation that would expose the contradiction.

structural_cues: Two assertions of being together are contradicted by scattered hearts.
Fortifications and walls precede an explicit correction of the observer's supposition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies outer assembly, enclosure, supposition, and inner dispersal; I infer that the focus pair distinguishes coherent power from simulated hardness. Alternatively, the contrast may diagnose only this group.

changed_reading.before: Invincibility is pictured as exterior hardness, numbers, and enclosure.
changed_reading.after: Divine invincibility is internally coherent order rather than facade; wisdom detects when apparent wholeness conceals scattered centers.

context_deltas.mechanism: The self must inspect what it sends ahead, then is warned that loss of divine remembrance causes loss of access to its own identity. Against that reversible self-loss, completed cosmic praise becomes a temporal norm: creation bears its relation already, while the human must recover it consciously.

activation_trace.role: The completed devotional act supplies the norm against which human attention is measured.
Sound knowledge makes self-inspection and consequence part of wise order.
Directed insight supplies deliberate examination of consequence.
Own identity makes examiner and examined object coincide.
Advancing something ahead gives present action a future arrow.
Loss of remembrance reverses relation to God and self-knowledge together.
The self as own identity is what becomes inaccessible after relational failure.

structural_cues: Inspection of what the self advances for tomorrow is followed by reciprocal forgetting involving God and self.
The focus uses a completed verbal form while this section makes future orientation an explicit task.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies self-inspection, forward placement, and reciprocal forgetting; I infer that cosmic praise is a norm of temporal and relational coherence. Alternatively, the focus perfect may bear no contrastive temporal force.

changed_reading.before: The opening surveys an external cosmos already praising God.
changed_reading.after: That completed relation becomes a mirror: remembering God coheres identity across present and future, while forgetting reverses praise into self-loss.

context_deltas.mechanism: Downward delivery meets an elevated solid mass and produces lowering plus fracture. This supplies a nonvocal grammar for earthly praise: hardness becomes the medium whose yielding displays the difference between created solidity and divine invincibility.

activation_trace.role: Material movement makes lowering and splitting available as enacted praise.
Created solidity supplies the property tested and shown not to be ultimate.
Delivery downward supplies directional contact between revelation and matter.
An elevated solid mass provides the strongest material test case.
Lowering and submission give the mass a directional response.
A split in hard material makes submission physically visible.

structural_cues: The hypothetical sequence is visual: downward placement, lowering, and fracture.
The image is followed by an invitation to human reflection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delivery, maximal solidity, lowering, and fracture; I infer an instance of material praise disclosing created versus divine strength. Alternatively, the mountain may remain only a comparison for human reception.

changed_reading.before: Universal praise is imagined as sound added to inert matter.
changed_reading.after: Matter praises through truthful response: concentrated solidity lowers and opens, making its created limit visible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The close expands the focus across hidden and witnessed reality, purification from association, and creating and forming; it then repeats cosmic exoneration in an ongoing form and restores the wisdom attribute. The opening becomes an envelope around the intervening reversals and redistributions.

activation_trace.role: Opening exoneration supplies the act resumed and specified at the close.
Exact ordering lets the close gather intervening mechanisms into one frame.
What is concealed extends totality beyond visible spatial domains.
Observed presence supplies the visible counterpart to the hidden realm.
Purity sharpens the exonerating content of the opening predicate.
Association identifies the rival attribution that exoneration rejects.
Bringing creation into being explains why the praising totality belongs within divine order.
Giving distinct form lets diverse entities share one predicate without losing difference.
Resumed exoneration changes the completed opening act into an ongoing frame.
The repeated exact-order attribute seals opening and close.

structural_cues: The final verse repeats the focus cosmic subject and attribute pair but changes the praise verb from completed to ongoing form.
The closing name sequence stands between denial of association and the repeated cosmic clause.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a near-verbatim recurrence, a verbal shift, and roots for hiddenness, witness, purification, creation, and form; I infer a frame for the whole sequence. Alternatively, the recurrence may be compositional closure only.

changed_reading.before: The first verse is a detachable cosmic prologue.
changed_reading.after: It opens a temporal and theological envelope: creation has praised and continues to praise while intervening history displays the power and order being praised.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This uses the packet's non-dominant و س م target for the focus root س م و and turns the sky-earth merism into rainfall. It remains anchored by the split inventory and fertile-earth branch, but should be presented as exploratory material activation, not lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus places the س م و occurrence over the ء ر ض occurrence inside one shared act of س ب ح.

activation_trace.role: First rain marking soil with growth supplies a visible downward inscription.
Productive ground receives the mark and renders it as growth.
Flowing motion connects upper source to lower material.

changed_reading.before: Heavens and earth are two locations whose inhabitants praise.
changed_reading.after: The upper realm's flowing praise can be imagined as first rain visibly marking receptive earth with growth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activates the packet's branch-distant س م م target under س م و. It remains anchored to the opposed upper/lower poles and repair-oriented ح ك م branch, but must be rendered as a relational overlay rather than an etymological claim.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus coordinates upper and lower creation and caps their joint act with repair-oriented wisdom.

activation_trace.role: Repair between unlike parties turns the upper term into a trigger for relation across difference.
The lower pole supplies the unlike counterpart held in relation.
Restraint for repair governs the inferred upper-lower concord.

changed_reading.before: The heavens-earth pair functions only as a merism for space.
changed_reading.after: The pair can also activate concord: unlike upper and lower poles are held together in repaired relation, and their joint praise is that concord.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The closing occurrence record groups names and heavens under one س م و root, allowing the naming branch to feed back into the focus. This is anchored by the exact record and closing repetition, but should be called a semiotic echo, not a claim that heavens means names.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus س م و occurrence returns in the closing cosmic clause beside another occurrence from the same root concerning names.

activation_trace.role: The ordinary upper-domain sense preserves the spatial anchor.
Naming as indication lets the upper domain also function as a sign.
The shared occurrence record joins names and heavens through signifying designation.
Repeated exoneration makes signification a possible mode of cosmic praise.

changed_reading.before: The heavens are only a spatial component of praising creation.
changed_reading.after: The heavens can additionally be heard as a named visible sign whose manifested identity clears God from false description.

strongest_changes: Fortress failure changed praise from background speech into material testimony by reversal.
Land treatment and return-to-circulation changed wisdom into governance of matter, property, and social flow.
The mountain supplied a nonvocal grammar in which created solidity truthfully lowers and opens.
The closing recurrence changed the opening into an envelope around the surah's mechanisms.
summary.what_was_special: Split mappings supported three contained readings: rain marking fertile earth, repair between unlike cosmic poles, and the closing root record linking names with heavens. They remain exploratory overlays rather than lexical substitutions.
remaining_uncertainties: Historical and social mechanisms may enact cosmic praise, or may only display the focus attributes while praise remains a frame.
Non-dominant mappings under س م و may support latent wordplay or only bounded association.
The completed-to-ongoing verbal frame may indicate temporal totality or primarily stylistic closure.
